objectives.en: Explain how an AC generator works.
Use ε = NBAω sin ωt and ε₀ = NBAω.

narration.en: At a hydroelectric station like Sharavathi, falling water spins coils in strong magnetic fields. With every turn of a coil the emf rises, falls and reverses: alternating current.
narration.kn: ಶರಾವತಿಯಂತಹ ಜಲವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೀಳುವ ನೀರು ಪ್ರಬಲ ಕಾಂತಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುರುಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸುತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಏರುತ್ತದೆ, ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ದಿಕ್ಕು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್.

body.en: A coil of N turns and area A rotates with angular speed ω in a uniform field B. The angle between B and the coil's normal is θ = ωt, so Φ = NBA cos ωt and $\varepsilon = -d\Phi/dt = NBA\omega\sin\omega t$. The peak emf is ε₀ = NBAω and the frequency is ν = ω/2π. The emf is maximum when the plane of the coil is parallel to B (flux zero, but changing fastest) and zero when the plane is perpendicular to B (flux maximum). Slip rings and carbon brushes take the current out of the rotating coil.
body.kn: B ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ω ಕೋನೀಯ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗುವ ಸುರುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ε = NBAω sin ωt; ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ε₀ = NBAω. ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಗರಿಷ್ಠ, ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಗರಿಷ್ಠವಾದಾಗ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಶೂನ್ಯ.

narration.en: A coil turning in a field has flux N B A cos omega t, so its emf is N B A omega sin omega t. The peak emf is N B A omega. The emf is largest when the flux is zero and zero when the flux is largest.
narration.kn: B ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ω ಕೋನೀಯ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗುವ ಸುರುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ε = NBAω sin ωt; ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ε₀ = NBAω. ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಗರಿಷ್ಠ, ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಗರಿಷ್ಠವಾದಾಗ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಶೂನ್ಯ.

title.en: On the board: the AC generator

narration.en: A coil of N turns and area A spins at angular speed ω in a field B; θ = ωt is the angle between its normal and B. The flux linkage NBA cos ωt keeps changing, so the emf is NBAω sin ωt, with peak value ε₀ = NBAω. The emf is a sine wave: largest when the coil's plane lies along B, and zero when the coil faces B. Example: 100 turns of area 0.1 m² turning at 0.5 revolution per second in 0.01 T give ε₀ = 100 × 0.01 × 0.1 × π ≈ 0.314 V. Slip rings and brushes carry this alternating emf out of the spinning coil.

caption.en: Turning a coil in a magnetic field induces a current in it. Slip rings carry it out to the circuit.

narration.en: Turn the coil slowly and watch the meter. When the coil's sides cut straight across the field lines the emf is largest; when they slide along the lines it falls to zero, and then it reverses.

body.en: Flux follows cos ωt and emf follows sin ωt. When one is at its peak, the other is zero.
